title: Stop Guessing Risk. Use Two Standard Deviations.
description:
Join the Lossdog Here: https://tinyurl.com/2bhryjxz

How I got here: 

24 yrs old: Started at Drexel, then took the CBOE floor in 1981.

24–42: Two decades in the pits as a market maker, money manager, and owner of a prop trading firm.

42 yrs old: Co-founded thinkorswim with Scott Sheridan — the first platform to hand retail traders professional options tools.

50 yrs old: Took it public under the ticker SWIM.

52 yrs old: Sold thinkorswim to TD Ameritrade for $750M.

53 yrs old: Started tastytrade. Turned financial education into a live daily network.

60 yrs old: Launched the brokerage arm.

64 yrs old: Sold tastytrade to IG Group for $1.1B.

68 yrs old: Left tastylive and started building again.

He's been on camera nearly every trading day for 15 years. Thousands of hours of it, almost none of it searchable.

That's what this channel is for. 3 clips a day, each one answering a single question.

Trade small. Trade often. And never listen to anyone, including me.


Trade Inside Two Standard Deviations

From Tom Sosnoff's appearance on In The Money by Zerodha.
Watch the full episode: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jstOWsWvbAU
Segment begins at 00:40:26.
